theorem smooth_iff_continuous_comp_smooth_immersion
  {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
  {M N : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace N]
  (f : M → N) :
  Smooth 𝕜 f ↔ 
  Continuous f ∧ 
  ∀ {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] (φ : P → M), 
    SmoothImmersion 𝕜 φ → Smooth 𝕜 (f ∘ φ) := sorry
